test_title: SSC Steno 2021 Official Paper (Held on: 12 Nov 2021 Shift 1
subject: general
question:
**Select the correct direct form of the given sentence.**

Vinod asked the salesman if he could show him a good quality gold watch.

options.text: Vinod said to the salesman, “Could he show me a good quality gold watch?”
Vinod said to the salesman, “Can you show me a good quality gold watch?”
Vinod said to the salesman, “Can you show him a good quality gold watch?”
Vinod said to the salesman, “If you can show me a good quality gold watch?”

solution:
The correct answer is: **Vinod said to the salesman, “Can you show me a good quality gold watch?”**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** 

 
• The given sentence is in indirect speech and we need to convert it to direct speech.
 
• When we change an indirect speech to direct speech, we must follow these rules:
 
 
• If the indirect part of the sentence use '**asked**' as reporting verb then a "**question mark**" should be added in the direct speech part.
 
• The indirect speech part is always stated as a statement form. so a "**full stop**" is used instead of a question tag.
 
• The reporting verb 'asked' changes to **'said to'.**
 
• The conditional 'if' is replaced with inverted commas ("...") to show the direct speech part.
 
• A comma (,) is added after the direct speech part.
 
• The first word of the direct speech is in capital letter.
 
• The modal '**could**' changes to '**can**' to show the direct speech part.
 
• The pronoun 'he' changes to 'you' and '**him**' changes to '**me**'
 
 

Thus, option 2 is the correct answer.

Hence, direct speech is - *Vinod said to the salesman, “Can you show me a good quality gold watch?”*
